lede: Generate the template, fill it in by hand with a dark pen, photograph each page, and turn your handwriting into an installable font.
step2: Write one letter per box with a dark pen (0.5 mm+), sitting on the solid line. The grey ghost marks the size: write over it.
step3: Photograph each page from above in good light, then process the photos to build your font.
note: All grey vanishes in processing — only your ink survives.
headerLine1: myFont — write each letter large, inside its box, sitting on the solid line.
headerLine2: Grey ghost = suggested size, write over it. Dark pen (0.5 mm+). Photograph from above in good light.
